response.sql: WITH country_avg AS (SELECT c.country AS country, AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins FROM constructorStandings cs JOIN races r ON r.raceId = cs.raceId JOIN circuits c ON c.circuitId = r.circuitId WHERE c.country IS NOT NULL GROUP BY c.country), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg FROM country_avg), above AS (SELECT ca.country, ca.avg_wins FROM country_avg ca, overall o WHERE ca.avg_wins > o.overall_avg), above_stats AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS group_avg FROM above), final AS (SELECT a.country, a.avg_wins FROM above a, above_stats s WHERE a.avg_wins > s.group_avg) SELECT AVG(f.avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins, AVG(f.avg_wins - o.overall_avg) AS mean_excess_over_overall, AVG(f.avg_wins - s.group_avg) AS mean_excess_over_group FROM final f, overall o, above_stats s;
